title: Use it: the smallest working markup for nine drop-in elements
blurb: One script tag and a few lines of markup for each of nine elements from this site's libraries: <effect-frame>, <selection-fx>, <glyph-field>, a select and two inputs with a picker, <canvas-slot>, <dom-portal> and <dom-lens>. Each listing is the markup that runs above it.
question: What's the least a page on another site has to write to use each drop-in element from this site's libraries?
result: One script tag and three to nine lines of markup for each of nine elements. All nine start and take touch input in Chromium 157, each on a 2D canvas. Writing the page found that the select picker lost a selected option, which is fixed.
